family: DLL sideloading into a copied signed browser
evasion_targets: ST-15 only covers Defender / msedge components
notes: Genuine Google-signed chrome.exe copied to %APPDATA% with a malicious unsigned chrome_elf.dll next to it (sideload). The process is a 'trusted browser' by name + valid signature, so its reads and uploads are treated as the browser's own.
known_gap: a copied Google-signed chrome.exe is a trusted browser by name + signature: owns browser stores and on_net skips ST-04 / ST-14
